## History

Before his death, Kenneth attended church with Mrs. Ford, where he screamed upon seeing [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md) and had to be carried out of the building. His life was cut short when he fell off a large load of hay as it entered a barn, causing a wagon wheel to crush his body. Following the fatal accident, Kenneth was buried in the graveyard overlooking the harbor.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P18](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0018), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P54](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0054)_
